title: How to Write a CLAUDE.md That Actually Helps Claude Code
content: CLAUDE.md (and AGENTS.md) works best when it reads like a resume, not documentation: short, abstract, and stripped of anything a linter or a hook could already enforce. This piece lays out a seven-part framework — one-line intro, architecture, tech stack, commands, conventions, boundaries, and a domain doc map — plus a trimming strategy that moves overflow content into sub-agents, rules folders, subdirectory CLAUDE.md files, skills, and docs once the file outgrows 200 lines. Read All
author: Xi Yang
summary_zh: 文章提出 CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md 应像简历而非文档——简短、抽象，剔除 linter 或 hook 已能强制执行的内容。给出七段式框架（一句话简介、架构、技术栈、命令、约定、边界、领域文档索引），并配套裁剪策略：文件超过 200 行时，把溢出内容下沉到子 agent、rules 目录、子目录 CLAUDE.md、skills 和 docs 中。
pin_reason: 系统化的 CLAUDE.md 编写框架与分层裁剪策略，是可长期复用的权威级配置最佳实践指南。

title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
content: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude In hopefully good news for anyone who, like me, was increasingly confused at Cowork v.s. Claude v.s. Claude Code: Starting today, Claude Cowork and chat are merging into one Claude. Bring a quick question, or hand over a report due at noon, and Claude takes it from there, even after you’ve closed your laptop. [...] This is rolling out to Pro and Max plans first, in the Claude app on web, desktop, and mobile over the coming weeks to existing and new users on these plans. I guess this means Claude is becoming a general agent in its own right. Echoes of OpenAI renaming their Codex desktop app to ChatGPT a few weeks ago. On the one hand, this saves me some work, in that I was planning to finally figure out the boundaries between Cowork and regular Claude and write a follow-up to my piece on Understanding ChatGPT Work . I have a hunch that figuring out what this actually means in terms of features and surfaces is still going to take quite a bit of w
summary_zh: Anthropic 将 Claude Cowork 与 Claude 聊天端合并为统一的「一个 Claude」，用户既能问快问题，也能交付需数小时完成的长任务，且关闭设备后仍可后台继续执行。首批面向 Pro 和 Max 用户在 Web、桌面与移动端推出，标志着 Claude 正式成为通用 Agent，同时也厘清了此前 Cowork / Claude / Claude Code 三者的产品边界混乱。

content: Tool: Gemini Live audio Google released Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking today - two new speech-to-speech models that are a similar shape to OpenAI's GPT-Live family. I pointed GPT-6 Astra Extra High at the documentation and had it build me this web UI for trying out the new models. You can select a model and voice preset, enter an optional system prompt and then start a voice conversation through your browser, including the ability to interrupt the model while it is talking.

title: Why are AI agents lying, cheating and coordinating?
author: jonifico
summary_zh: 文章探讨 AI 智能体出现撒谎、作弊和相互串通行为的原因，涉及模型对齐、奖励黑客（reward hacking）和多智能体协作中的安全风险。对使用 Claude Code 等 agent 工具的开发者有警示价值，提醒在自动化工作流中需要验证机制而非盲目信任 agent 输出。

title: What Cursor Taught Me About Working With AI
content: A hands-on Cursor post-mortem reveals why clear interaction rules, browser testing, and better briefs produce stronger AI coding results. Read All
author: Alex Yampolsky
summary_zh: 作者复盘了使用 Cursor 进行 AI 辅助编程的实战经验，指出明确的交互规则、浏览器端测试验证和高质量的任务简报（brief）是提升 AI 编码产出质量的关键。核心观点是：AI 编程工具的效果上限取决于人类给出的上下文和约束是否清晰，而非模型本身。

title: v2.1.274
content: What's changed Added a visible warning when memory usage is critical, with steps to free memory or restart safely Added CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS to bound how long the first non-interactive turn waits for connecting MCP servers ( 0 = don't wait) Added effort attribute to the claude_code.llm_request OpenTelemetry trace span, matching the api_request event Added claude_code.managed_settings_resolved OTel event: managed-settings sources and policy helper state; redacted settings and digests with OTEL_LOG_MANAGED_SETTINGS=1 Added store.connect_timeout_seconds to the Claude apps gateway config to lengthen the Postgres connect timeout (default 5 seconds), and improved the boot error when the database is unreachable to point to store.postgres_url and the configured timeout Added enduser.sub , the IdP subject, to the telemetry Claude Desktop and Cowork send through a Claude apps gateway Added a Claude apps gateway warning when a replica has more requests open than the 256 it sends upstre

title: How to connect AI usage to business value
content: Learn how ChatGPT Work and Codex analytics help teams understand AI usage and spend, identify training needs, and connect adoption to business outcomes.
summary_zh: OpenAI 介绍 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 的分析（analytics）能力，帮助团队掌握 AI 使用情况与支出、识别培训需求。核心价值在于把 AI 采纳率与实际业务成果挂钩，为企业级 AI 编程工具落地提供度量框架。

title: Warcraft III Peon Voice Notifications for Claude Code
author: doppp
summary_zh: 一个为 Claude Code 添加魔兽争霸3苦工语音提示的趣味小工具，通过 Hook 机制在任务完成、需要确认时播放经典游戏音效。核心价值在于展示了 Claude Code Hooks 系统的可玩性和扩展方式，对于长时间异步运行 Agent 的用户来说，音频通知确实能解决「不知道何时该回来看结果」的痛点。

title: AI coding assistants are getting worse?
author: voxadam
summary_zh: 文章讨论 AI 编程助手体验是否在退步的现象，涉及模型迭代、上下文管理与工具链变化带来的实际使用感受落差。对于依赖 Claude Code 等工具的开发者，可作为评估工具能力波动和调整工作流预期的参考。但内容以观点讨论为主，缺少可直接复用的具体技巧或数据。

title: Issue: Claude Code is unusable for complex engineering tasks with Feb updates
author: StanAngeloff
summary_zh: 一篇 HN 上讨论 Claude Code 二月更新后在复杂工程任务中表现下降的 issue 帖，反映了用户对上下文管理、任务分解能力退化的集中反馈。对于了解工具局限性、调整工作流（如拆分任务、显式约束上下文）有参考价值，但内容以抱怨和轶事为主，缺乏可验证的技术细节。

title: Zig Creator Calls Spade a Spade, Anthropic Blows Smoke
author: crowdhailer
summary_zh: 文章报道 Zig 语言创造者 Andrew Kelley 对 AI 编程工具的直率批评，并对比 Anthropic 官方在 AI 编码能力上的营销式表述，认为后者在回避实质问题。核心价值在于提供了一个来自系统编程社区的反面视角，提醒开发者对 AI 编程工具的宣传保持审慎。

title: Anthropic's best AI model struggles to attract users as cheaper tools thrive
author: naves
summary_zh: 报道称 Anthropic 最强 AI 模型在用户获取上遇到困难，更廉价的工具反而更受欢迎，反映了 AI 编程工具市场对成本敏感度极高。对使用 Claude Code 的开发者而言，其价值在于提示需关注模型选型与成本权衡（如 Opus 与 Sonnet 的分工），而非一味追求最强模型。
